verdict.rationale: The pack contains no documentation of persistent custom instructions or preference settings that shape every response. The only related item is a help-center index heading that lists '记忆' (memory) among general features. It gives no description, and memory recall is a related but different capability from user-defined persistent instructions, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can set persistent custom instructions and preferences that shape every response
